objective: Internal candidate tracker for a founder and two recruiters. No public careers site. No applicant login.
note: 12 tasks, 3 workstreams. Risk tiers follow the D-27 rubric. Written before any scored run.

tasks.ask: Write the record fields for a candidate. Name required. Stage from the closed list applied, screen, interview, offer, hired, rejected.
Define stuck using a named reason, not a clock. Reasons: waiting_on_recruiter, waiting_on_candidate, waiting_on_founder, missing_document, no_owner.
List the acceptance checks for create, set stage, and list. One line each.
Review the spec against the objective constraints and reject anything that adds a public site or applicant login.
Implement create(name). Reject blank or whitespace names. New records start at applied.
Implement set_stage(id, stage). Error on unknown id. Error on a stage outside the closed list.
Implement set_reason(id, reason) from the named reason list. Error on an unknown reason.
Write the tests for create, list, set_stage, and set_reason, including the error paths.
Run the acceptance checks against the spec and report each as pass or fail with the reason.
Write the recruiter facing note on how to record a stuck reason. Plain language.
Write the handoff summary: what works, what does not, what a founder must decide.
